impact.affected_asset: ArduinoJson process memory state during MessagePack deserialization and code-point encoding.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause the documented sanitizer finding through parser input in the OSS-Fuzz setting; exploitability and confidentiality, integrity, or control-flow effects are not established.

causal_trace.summary: Arbitrary fuzzer-supplied bytes are provided to LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput and passed to deserializeMsgPack().
A newly constructed Codepoint did not establish a defined _highSurrogate value before later code-point handling could consume that member; the fix adds constructor initialization to zero.
The issue-specific crash record identifies a use-of-uninitialized-value whose leading crash-state frame is Utf8::encodeCodepoint, followed by JsonDeserializer<BoundedReader> frames.
The recorded observable is an MSan use-of-uninitialized-value finding; the supplied material does not establish exploitation or a stronger security consequence.

failure.operation: Read/use of an uninitialized value in Utf8::encodeCodepoint

primary_invariant.statement: Codepoint::_highSurrogate must have a defined initial value before Codepoint append/encoding logic can read it.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The pre-fix Codepoint class lacked a constructor initializing _highSurrogate; the remediation adds Codepoint() : _highSurrogate(0) {}.

quality.review_notes: The immutable OSV record supplies an issue-specific MSan crash type and crash-state prefix, and the maintainer patch directly initializes the implicated member. The restricted issue locator exposes no testcase, and the bundle lacks a sanitizer replay log, full vulnerable Utf16.hpp context, and an issue-specific regression test. The generic reproducer can feed files to the fuzzer entrypoint but does not supply this issue's input; no deterministic reproduction is claimed.

remediation.invariant_restored: Codepoint construction initializes _highSurrogate to zero, so subsequent state handling begins from a defined value.
